title: Nemotron 3.5 Bolt E4B via Ollama
slug_note: A small NVIDIA assistant model built on Gemma 4 E4B; 7-8 GB tag.

variation.quant_detail: Ollama's `nemotron-3.5-bolt:e4b` tag, 7.2GB - 7.9GB; a separate `e4b-q4_K_M` tag also exists

requirements.notes: Estimate from the tag size plus KV headroom. Not measured.

steps.text: Install Ollama (see Step 0 in Quick start).

caveats: No speed or memory numbers recorded yet; the size is Ollama's listed tag size.
Ollama's default context is small; raise num_ctx for long documents or coding agents.
Context: NVIDIA's BF16 card gives 64K input / 64K output; Ollama lists 128K.

sources.note: NVIDIA card: 8B (4B effective), built on Gemma-4-E4B
